name: codeworker-codegraph
description: CodeWorker CodeGraph plugin for Codex. Use it to query CodeWorker's local symbol graph, callers/callees, imports, and RAG context before broad codebase exploration.

interface.shortDescription: Query CodeWorker's local code graph before exploring files
interface.longDescription: CodeWorker CodeGraph gives Codex a local-first workflow for codebase exploration. It uses CodeWorker's SQLite RAG and symbol graph index to find entry points, relationships, and impact hints before reading files. This CodeWorker implementation follows graph-first ideas from colbymchenry/codegraph by Colby Mchenry, licensed under MIT.
defaultPrompt: Use CodeWorker CodeGraph to find the login flow entry points
Use CodeWorker CodeGraph before editing the model launch path
